author: GunsForHands03
body: In a map that me and my brother that might make, we aren't sure if we will, yet. But, if we make 1 quadrant of the walls, is it alright if a staff member uses world edit to make the rest of the quadrants exactly the same? or is that not possible? If a staff member could give me a response, that would be great.

title: World Edit help

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body: You should just download a Walls map template instead, which means that you will not have to worry about the walls not being aligned.

replies.author: MLGtino
replies.body: Doesn't even have to be a staff member. Just find someone who knows something about it (most people in Teamspeak could help you most likely, maybe a mapdev) and contact them instead. Just give them credit. The same applies just in case you don't know YAML either.

replies.author: source_route
replies.body: place a sand block (make sure its falling),  exit the world when its falling, clone the block in mcedit until u create 4 quadrants, then set a time for when they fall (im pretty theirs a filter for that) BAYM
